defs.def: at the present time, in contrast with the past 现今；现在；目前

ex.s: Nowadays, when my own trainees apply for positions else where, I encourage them to ____34____ feedback.
ex.t: 如今，当我自己的受训者申请别处职位时，我鼓励他们____34____（寻求）反馈。

ex.s: Nowadays supermarket tomatoes ___34___ perfect but taste of water.
ex.t: 如今超市里的西红柿___34___完美，吃起来却像水一样没味道。

ex.s: I would never have imagined that this could happen nowadays.
ex.t: 我认为这是一个孩子在丢失重要物品时的完美经历——失去它，感受那份失落的全貌，然后奇迹般地失而复得。

ex.s: Statistics show that the average number of births per woman has fallen from 4.9 in the early 1960s to 2.5 nowadays.
ex.t: 统计数据显示，每位女性的平均生育数从20世纪60年代初的4.9下降到现在的2.5。
如今，他体格健壮，皮肤晒得黝黑。

ex.s: Nowadays, we can move around the world and still stay in touch with the people that we want to remain friends with.
ex.t: 如今，我们可以在世界各地活动，仍然与我们想要保持友谊的人保持联系。

ex.s: Nowadays, we can…stay in touch with the people that we want to remain friends with.
ex.t: 如今，我们可以……与我们想要保持友谊的人保持联系。

ex.s: Nowadays, some people choose to have the dinner in a restaurant, but not everyone is keen on this idea.
ex.t: 如今，一些人选择在餐厅吃年夜饭，但不是每个人都热衷于这个想法。

ex.s: Nowadays, more and more countries around the world are holding celebrations for Chinese Spring Festival.
ex.t: 如今，世界上越来越多的国家为中国春节举办庆祝活动。
